specification.basis: reviews/auto-cycle-009.md H027: original adjacent pages, zero offset, reused additive stream; no new key family or offsets
specification.hypothesis: C_A[i]=P_A[i]+K[i] and C_B[i]=P_B[i]+K[i] mod29, so D[i]=P_A[i]-P_B[i] mod29
specification.representation: Original rune indices 0..28, F ordinary. Keep raw source and ordinal mappings. A page contributes its rune prefix before its first ASCII alphanumeric literal. Soft separators and punctuation do not consume clock. No shift, reverse, reorder, skip, or tuning.

coverage.universe: All 55 original consecutive pairs LP2/n,LP2/n+1 for n=0..54; all 56 pages receive a coverage row
coverage.overlap: min(legal prefix lengths), at least 30 symbols; unpaired tails reported
coverage.grid: Stop at first ASCII letter/digit; LP2/49 pre-grid rune prefix remains applicable, LP2/50 has none, LP2/51 begins with grid and has no legal page-origin prefix; never bridge 49 to 51
coverage.reset: Same clock origin at first rune of each page; no inferred chapters

model.training: data/synthetic/training.txt only, fixed lp_lab.synthetic.encode_text; no LP plaintext or heldout in worker
model.plaintext: Add-one-smoothed unigram pi and row-normalized add-one bigram transition T
model.difference: Add-one-smoothed joint bigram J; Q[a,b]=sum_x,y J[x,y]*J[(x-a)%29,(y-b)%29], then normalize each Q row. Initial difference piD[a]=sum_x pi[x]*pi[(x-a)%29]. This is a fixed first-order approximation, not the exact hidden-state marginal.
model.score: Log likelihood ratio of observed D under piD,Q against iid uniform29. First floor(2*n/3) is discovery; remaining suffix is heldout. The first suffix term conditions on last discovery D. No refit on either segment.
model.prediction_limit: Heldout is a sequential conditional density prediction of D, not independent plaintext/key suffix prediction.
model.decode: Exact 29-state Viterbi over P_A; P_B=P_A-D. First decode discovery only, then freeze its last pair and decode suffix conditional on those states. Return explicit P_A,P_B and K_A=C_A-P_A,K_B=C_B-P_B. Shared K and roundtrip do not establish correctness.
model.tie: Smallest previous A state, then smallest final A state

synthetic_gate.plaintexts: Verifier-only heldout encode_text: A at i*13, B at 598+i*13, length fixed. Within a case windows are disjoint; across cases windows overlap, so counts are diagnostics, not independent confidence trials.
synthetic_gate.positive: Independent uniform29 K per positive, same K used for both natural windows
synthetic_gate.negative: Same natural windows with independent uniform29 K_A,K_B; index modulo20; exactly99
synthetic_gate.detection: Both discovery and holdout log likelihood ratios >= ln(100)
synthetic_gate.recovery: Each of A and B must recover >=0.60 exact rune fraction separately in discovery and holdout; report full exact plaintext/key match independently
synthetic_gate.pass: At least18/20 positives meet detection and recovery; 0/99 independent-stream negatives meet detection
synthetic_gate.failure: inconclusive; do not dispatch LP2 or calculate LP2 scores; do not tune v1 after results

lp2_acceptance.null: Within each legal prefix, shuffle only even-numbered original pages; odd pages fixed. Each pair has exactly one shuffled page and each shared even page uses the same permutation for both neighbors in that replicate.
lp2_acceptance.statistics: Two score columns per applicable pair; standardize observed+999 controls together, maxT across all columns; plus-one p with1e-12 tie tolerance
lp2_acceptance.lead: Both segments logBF>=ln100 and both maxT p<=.01; only unverified candidate pair, never decryption
lp2_acceptance.negative: Complete gate, independent verification and all999 controls with no lead: scoped negative for this detector/model/alignment only

specification.isolation: Guarded stdlib-only worker receives ciphertext, opaque job id and training counts; no answers, plaintext, generation seed, filesystem/process/network access. Gate dispatch precedes any LP2 dispatch.
specification.validation: Independent scalar backward Bellman optimum, independent path objective, difference/score and roundtrip checks; short brute force oracle and mutation tests. Exact comparison to verifier-only synthetic plaintext and keys.
specification.stage_order: Implement and execute synthetic gate first. Only if it passes, implement the already frozen formal control specification and freeze that implementation before any LP2 score; failed gate ends v1 without implementing controls.
specification.provenance: Before worker execution freeze spec/source/code hashes, public gate ciphertext, private answers, model and coverage. Save worker stdout/stderr/exit code, complete or partial controls and checkpoint, reproduction ZIP and CRC/content verification.
uncovered: Alternative key streams or plaintext models
Grid symbol consumption or post-grid reset
Exact recovery of unknown LP2 plaintext without an independent anchor
